(' + String(pj.auditFailureReason || 'reason not recorded').slice(0,200) + ')' : 'The image was not a government-issued identity document, so no audit was performed and nothing was sent to the sender.') + tail, void_reason: un ? null : 'Not a KYC submission: the vision auditor classified the image as not an identity document.', voided_at: un ? null : $now.toUTC().toISO() }, pd.tenant_id ? { tenant_id: pd.tenant_id } : {})); })() }}

nodes.name: Record Non-Document
nodes.notes: verdict must be one of PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED/ESCALATED -- kyc_documents_verdict_check. It used to write 'NOT_A_DOCUMENT' there, which 400'd, and because this node both swallows its errors and is terminal, the row silently never existed while the image sat in Storage. The classification now lives in document_type, which is free text.

nodes.name: Count Previous KYC Rejections

parameters.name: or

nodes.notes: Replaced 30 Aug 2026. Was a Supabase getAll on communication_logs with no limit, no returnAll and no orderBy, filtered on lead_email alone. Now a PostgREST read of kyc_documents -- the table that already stores attempt_number on every rejection -- keyed on the full or=() identity set (email OR chat id OR the synthetic +<digits>@whatsapp.lead), ordered by attempt_number desc and limited to ONE row, so it returns a maximum rather than a count and cannot be truncated by unrelated BDC or drip traffic. Written as an HTTP node, not a Supabase node, because the Supabase node's filters are ANDed keyName/condition pairs and cannot express or=().

activeVersion.name: Auth Gate marks its refusal unattributed
activeVersion.description: Prefix the unauthorized throw with [NEXUS-UNATTRIBUTED] so the shared NEXUS Error Handler omits tenant_id and the anonymous caller's audit row falls to the quarantine tenant instead of ALBA CARS. Guard logic, connections and the trusted sub-workflow path are unchanged.
